community.description: The community the role belongs to.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the role.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.description: No role exists at the given record key.

errors.name: RoleProtected
errors.description: The role is marked protected and cannot be deleted.

errors.name: RoleHierarchy
errors.description: The role is at or above the caller's highest role position.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
